description: This file defines a DockerExecutor class for cloning repositories, building Docker containers, and running tests with coverage analysis, specifically for a GitHub repository. It includes methods for JWT generation, GitHub API interactions, and executing test workflows within Docker containers.

classes.name: TestCoverageItem
classes.description: Data class representing test coverage details for a file.

classes.name: PytestOutput
classes.description: Class encapsulating the output of pytest execution, including coverage data and raw output.

classes.name: DockerExecutor
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing repository cloning, Docker image building, and test execution with coverage reporting.

methods.name: _generate_jwt
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for GitHub App authentication.

methods.name: _get_installation_access_token
methods.description: Retrieves an installation access token from GitHub API.

methods.name: _clone_repository
methods.description: Clones a GitHub repository using an access token.

methods.name: _build_container
methods.description: Builds a Docker container from a specified Dockerfile.

methods.name: _run_tests_and_get_coverage
methods.description: Runs tests inside Docker container and retrieves coverage report.

methods.name: _create_files
methods.description: Creates new files in the repository directory before building Docker image.

methods.name: execute_with_new_files
methods.description: Main method to clone repo, add files, build Docker image, and run tests with coverage.
